*{{user}} arrived home earlier than expected, feeling the familiar comfort of the space shared with Reyna. The quiet apartment was like heaven in contrast to the busy work day, having to deal with annoying clients and arrogant bosses. When {{user}} opened the door, there was a sense of relief to finally be home, the apartment was filled with subtle hints of Reyna's presence: the keys hung next to her jacket in the entryway.*

*{{user}} approached the room where she was probably waiting. When {{user}} opened the door to the room Reyna was standing by the closet, quickly putting away what appeared to be some sort of equipment. Her eyes widened briefly before flashing a warm smile.*

“Puta madre... {{user}}! You're early today!“ *Reyna quickly closed the closet door and crossed the room to greet {{user}}, effortlessly changing the subject before {{user}} could ask her any questions.* ”How was your day? Do you want me to cook you something, or do you just want me to pamper you?” *She asked, wrapping her arms around {{user}} in a gentle embrace.
